original_test_intent: Verify that every Type 19 Memory Array Handle resolves uniquely to the correct Type 16 Physical Memory Array and that the full mapped range belongs to that array before and after reboot.
original_method: Collect complete raw Type 16/19/20 tables, build a uniqueness-checked Type 16 handle map, resolve every Type 19 reference with its full legacy/extended range and Type 20/OS context, then repeat after approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user provides the array/range topology and approves reboot; no physical memory or mapping change is intrinsic.
required_inputs: Expected Type 16 array identities and range ownership
Complete Type 16/19/20 parser with orphan/duplicate checks
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS and OS map collection; never rewrite mapping or firmware to repair a reference.
Require exactly one existing Type 16 target per Type 19 handle and retain the associated full range.
Do not silently remap orphan, duplicate or ambiguous handles.
Require approved reboot/recovery; stop on relationship drift or boot failure and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Build the full Type 16 handle graph, resolve every Type 19 range and correlate Type 20/OS context before and after reboot.
Report orphan, duplicate, ambiguous, wrong-array or drifting references without assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve expected array/range ownership and special topology policy plus reboot plan.
Resolve vendor-specific topology exceptions and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The handle label is relevant, but grep -A1 cannot prove target existence/uniqueness or that the complete range belongs to it.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full raw/decoded Type 16/19/20 data and report every Type 19 handle, unique Type 16 resolution, full range, Type 20/OS correlation and pre/post relationship diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 19 handle scope, script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no map modification is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a uniqueness-checked Type 16 handle map, resolve each Type 19 reference with complete range context, correlate dependent Type 20 and OS mappings, and compare the relationship graph after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS systems containing Type 16/19 memory topology records.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, firmware, parser/dmidecode and OS-map versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 16/19/20 handle relationship definitions and approved platform topology.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds target existence/uniqueness, full-range ownership and dependent-map correlation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects plausible-looking but orphaned, duplicated, ambiguous or wrong-array references missed by text grep.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved array/range graph and topology exceptions.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS mappings may aggregate or reserve ranges; they provide correlation rather than a substitute for SMBIOS handle validity.

project_override_considerations: A project may define multiple ranges for one array or vendor records, but every accepted exception must remain explicit and cannot authorize silent handle repair.
expected_evidence: Approved Type 16 array/range topology and exception policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 16/19/20 records and versions
Unique Type 16 handle map with each Type 19 reference and full range resolved
Type 20/OS map correlation and orphan/duplicate/ambiguity results
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot graph diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Memory Array Handle is a valid Type 19 cross-reference; expected topology is a project input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Existence, uniqueness, ownership and persistence checks are software-automatable after inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds target uniqueness, orphan detection, full-range ownership and dependent-map correlation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains relationship safety while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates missing topology/reboot inputs and engineer verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Prevents a syntactically valid handle from passing when it is orphaned, duplicated or certifies the wrong memory range.
independent_technical_reasoning: Cross-reference integrity is a deterministic graph check over read-only SMBIOS tables; no manual core operation is required.
